title: Mama Suet
kicker: a Firstmoss forager carrying food and practical comfort
hook: a Firstmoss forager carrying food and practical comfort

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: An old turtle-folk elder carries bowls of glowing moss and greens, her shell wrapped with soft packs and a scarf worn smooth by years of road dust.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Stubborn tenderness in a worn shell. Carries a spoon worn thin by decades of feeding people, and a scarf from a child she fed in a failed harvest, to remind herself that care should travel. Fears the young accepting danger as the ordinary price of being...

blocks.body: A way forward A grounded question A scene-specific clue seed
